diagram_previews.alt: A 6 by 4 grid of unit squares with the diagonal drawn in red from the lower left to the upper right corner. The 8 squares whose interiors the diagonal crosses are shaded yellow, and the diagonal passes through the marked lattice point (3,2) in the middle. The bottom side is labelled 6 and the left side 4.
